cover_letter:
Dear Nestlé Recruitment Team,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the Digital Marketing Intern position at Nestlé, specifically with Nescafé Dolce Gusto, as advertised. The opportunity to contribute to a brand that combines innovation with a strong direct-to-consumer digital ecosystem, encompassing a loyalty program and diverse online platforms, deeply resonates with my professional aspirations in digital marketing.

My background as a Junior Digital Marketer and Web & SEO Specialist has equipped me with practical skills directly applicable to this role. I have extensive experience in creating engaging, keyword-targeted content for websites, managing content on platforms like WordPress (Elementor, Astra), and optimizing sites for SEO and GEO visibility. This includes implementing structured data and running technical audits, which would be valuable in enhancing Nescafé Dolce Gusto's website presence and e-content for machines, capsules, and promotions.

Furthermore, my proficiency extends to managing digital channels, including SEO, SEA, and social media integration, alongside using analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs. My certifications in GA4 and Google Ads Search reinforce my ability to handle various digital tools for content creation, implementation, and follow-up, aligning perfectly with responsibilities spanning Google, social media, and display campaigns. While my CV does not explicitly list email marketing, my experience with content creation and data management is directly transferable to contributing to newsletters and CRM-related content for the Premio loyalty program.

Fluent in English and proficient in Dutch, I am based in Belgium and eligible to undertake this internship. My unique blend of technical acumen, including Python scripting and daily use of AI/LLMs for content and audits, coupled with a deep understanding of digital marketing principles, makes me a proactive and adaptable candidate. I am eager to bring my analytical approach and creative problem-solving to your team, contributing measurably to Nescafé Dolce Gusto's online presence and consumer engagement goals.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I am excited about the prospect of learning and contributing to Nestlé and welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
•   Extensive experience in SEO (on-page, technical, keyword research, audits) and content creation for diverse client websites, including e-commerce platforms like proteinbox.com.tr.
•   Proficient in key digital marketing tools: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, WordPress, Elementor, Canva; holds certifications in GA4, Google Ads Search, and HubSpot Content Marketing.
•   Proven ability to design, build, and optimize websites, manage content, and integrate social media, contributing to measurable organic traffic growth.
•   Fluent in English and proficient in Dutch (Writing B1, Speaking A2+), complemented by a strong technical background in Computer Science coursework.
•   Hands-on experience with data analysis and reporting, tracking digital performance, and leveraging AI/LLMs for content and audits in a digital marketing context.
